_comment: A copy goes to <project>/.claude/ghorc.json. Any key may be omitted: missing values come from these defaults. Keys starting with _comment are ignored.

checks._comment: Project check commands. Agents run only fast; the lead runs full.

_comment_heavyCommands: Regexes (strings) of heavy commands that subagents may not run. Each is matched at the start of a command segment (after env assignments and npm run/npx), so write "^npm\s+run\s+test:e2e\b". An empty list means the hook forbids nothing.

readGuard._comment: Read hook: maxRepeat - how many reads of one file are allowed between edits of it; pdfPageBudget - PDF pages per agent; mediaByteBudget - image bytes per agent; mediaRoles - agent types that may read media; maxScreenshots - MCP screenshot/snapshot calls per agent; maxImageBytes - image size limit; leadNoMedia - the lead may not read PDFs and images.

heavyGuard._comment: requireLeadEnv: true - heavy commands are allowed only for a process with the environment variable GHORC_ROLE=lead.

thresholds._comment: Lead context thresholds in tokens: ctxPrepare - refresh STATE; ctxHandoff - take nothing new, hand the shift over.

lead._comment: Lead model and effort; used when launching the candidate in /handoff and by /ghorc:setup. remind: remind the lead about skill orc at start (GHORC_ROLE=lead always reminds; workers start with GHORC_ROLE=worker and get no reminder).

watchdog._comment: Transcript watchdog started by SessionStart for a lead session. autostart: start it detached (one per project root, pid file and heartbeat in <tmp>/ghorc-<user>); intervalSec: poll period; rateMiBPerMin: growth alarm; warnMiB: size to check; stopMiB: size alarm if still growing. Alerts go to <tmp>/ghorc-<user>/alerts-<root hash>.log; scripts/ctx.cjs --session <id> shows unread ones.

handoff._comment: Standing owner permissions. allowSendKeysExit: the new lead may send /exit to the old tab through herdr agent send-keys. candidatePermissionArgs: permission-mode arguments for the candidate (as for the old lead), for example ["--permission-mode", "acceptEdits"].

_comment_criticalPaths: Critical areas of the project (money, contracts, policy, hooks): edits here go to ghorc:reviewer-critical. Example: ["src/billing/**", "POLICY.md"].
